name: RT Deliveries
author: rtdeliveriesdev

sections.description:
Road Train Deliveries (RTD) is a powerful WooCommerce plugin that allows online store owners to send orders directly to the RTD delivery system, track parcels, and display current status updates—all within the WordPress dashboard. Automate logistics, reduce manual entry, and streamline your delivery process with seamless API integration.

Features include:
– Real-time order submission to RTD
– Fetch and select shop locations dynamically
– Parcel tracking & status updates
– Saves RTD delivery data to a local database
– Works with WooCommerce orders

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/rtdeliveries directory, or install it through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > RTD Settings to configure your API credentials.
sections.faq:
Do I need an RTD account?

Yes, you must have valid merchant credentials from Road Train Deliveries to use this plugin.

Where can I get the API Key?

You can get your API credentials from your RTD merchant dashboard or by contacting support at RTD’s website.

Is this plugin free to use?

Yes. However, usage of the RTD delivery service may be subject to their pricing and terms.
